Make spatial transit data into an sf linestring

ac_make_linestring.Rd

Turns the GPS locations and origin and destination points into sf linestrings. This function is mainly used internally. Try using ac_make_transit_spatial() instead. Also does some cleaning to remove points at 0, 0 and points that are more than 100 km from the nearest other points. This function is pretty slow. I recommend that you use it every time you get transit measurements, but it can be skipped if you want to save time

Usage

ac_make_linestring(lon, lat, noise_distance = 100)

Arguments

lon

vector of numeric longitude values

lat

vector of numeric latitude values

noise_distance

Distance in km to specify how far apart GPS points can be to remain in the sf linestring. See details

Value

sf object of linestring or point

Details

Points that are greater than noise_distance from the points before and after themselves will be removed from the linestring. This tends to remove erroneous points although it may remove some correct points. The default is set to 100 km. If you do not want points removed for their distance set the noise_distance to something really high.
